status: STATIC one bounded observation of Input representation, not optimization or native permission

phase_ownership.compile: Only enter/defer-close around actual w.Compile body, includes durable Begin/Reserve/Confirm + original assembly/Bind calls; no timestamps/context inference.
phase_ownership.dispatch: Only enter/end around original w.Dispatcher.Step in completeContextDecision.
phase_ownership.worker: Only enter/end around original w.Decision.Step in completeContextDecision; public Get/body observations after Step go back to other.
phase_ownership.other: All original setup/observe/failure/reopen/other paths outside the three explicit caller scopes; remains separate, not silently assigned worker.

begin_end_qualification: Token captures explicit phase+role+stage; counts attempted before original operation. Only real returned operation increments completed; errors preserve original error value/path; compare false is separate from an error. Incomplete counts remain visible.

stages_actual_calls.input_scan_sql_wall: Original exact SELECT body ... FOR UPDATE QueryRowContext.Scan statement, unchanged arguments and transaction. Wall includes client/network/lockwait/scan, not server execution.
stages_actual_calls.input_closed_json: Original closedJSON(body,&in), unchanged strict ParseJSON+typed unknown-field rejection+EOF validation.
stages_actual_calls.input_json_bytes: Original currentAttempt jsonBytes(in), unchanged original successful canonical serialization and finite bound; errors return before tuple/digest check as before.
stages_actual_calls.input_digest: Original currentAttempt digest(body) SHA256+hex. Wrapper invokes exactly once only when original earlier Tuple/full/revision conditions permit.
stages_actual_calls.full_input_compare: Original reflect.DeepEqual current vs in/out.Input in Bind/binding/StagePublication/dispatch/BeginCompile. Remaining Control/deadline/attempt guards stay in original OR order.
stages_actual_calls.attempt_tuple_compare: Original currentAttempt reflect.DeepEqual(root.Tuple,d.compileTuple(in)); not a full Input comparison. No later tuple/revision/control/digest check moved before this guard.

short_circuit_proof: CurrentAttempt order remains original tuple DeepEqual -> only if equal revision -> only if unchanged digest(body) -> only if equal control. Input jsonBytes is still before original guards and its error returns untouched. Full Input compare before currentControl in each original clause; dispatch gen/state/lease guard stays before fullInput guard. Compare/hash helpers return unchanged actual values, no extra original call.
error_limits: FirstCause uses existing claimCause type+errors.Is classification, not Error string/body; comparison false does not fabricate a typed business cause. No promise this counter closes retained-Now/transport failure coverage gap.
output_bounds: Only nonempty fixed cells, max6*(288+1)=1734 new lines; original coarse summary retained. No perinput maps/events/background jobs/newSQL/matrix.
drop_ambiguity: Invalid role/stage/phase increments dropped; nested/concurrent phase depth increments ambiguity and open depth reported at summary. Any actual drop/ambiguity/unmatched counts must be qualified, never zero-cost inferred.
cost_interpretation: Stage timed intervals are serial within each actual input path, but parent Current/Reserve/Confirm/compiler/Step totals are inclusive and overlap. SQL wall not CPU/server time; adding original parents to children invalid. Timer/begin/end/mutex/false bookkeeping/phase changes and summary IO have totaloverhead UNKNOWN, may change observed failure phase. New sample never rewrites old raw.
qualification_limit: Measurement neither accepts failed capacity nor authorizes next product change, extra native or fake retry. Original CPU descriptorClose UNKNOWN and static failedPut possibleeffect UNKNOWN persist.
